cl.x: Provide SikaSeal®-401 Aquarium where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).

SikaSeal® 401 Aquarium is a premium one-component room temperature vulcanising (RTV) silicone rubber that is safe for aquatic life and designed for sealing applications in aquariums, ponds and water pumps. It adheres very well to glass and aluminium, is UV resistant and has excellent gap filling properties.

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
cl.x: Ensure all surfaces are clean, dry and free from dust, grease and loose material. Remove all old gasket material from mating surfaces before cleaning with a residue free solvent and allow to completely dry.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
s: Cut the nozzle at a 45° angle to the desired bead size (3 mm is suitable for most applications) then apply a continuous and even bead along the joint.
Once the material has cured, the tank needs to be rinsed with water twice and then left for seven days prior to any fish being put in.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Uncured, excess SikaSeal® 401 Aquarium may be removed with Sika® Remover- 208 or another suitable solvent. Once cured, the excess sealant can be trimmed away from the edges with a knife.

s: SikaSeal® 401 Aquarium is not recommended for use in applications where it will be permanently exposed to temperatures exceeding 250°C or in contact with fuels. The above information is offered for general guidance only.
